title: Group 2 sulfates become less soluble
caption: Down group 2 the sulfates become less soluble: Ksp falls from 4.9 × 10⁻⁵ for CaSO₄ to 1.1 × 10⁻¹⁰ for BaSO₄, which is why acidified BaCl₂ is the test for sulfate. The hydroxides show the opposite trend.
alt: Bar chart of log₁₀ Ksp for calcium, strontium and barium sulfates, falling from −4.31 to −9.97.
